dedupe_keys.name: taiwan water resources agency reservoir conditions inflow level storage release flood operation and water open data platform

description: Taiwan's Water Resources Agency (WRA) publishes the water conditions of the reservoirs in Taiwan as open data: catchment rainfall, inflow, water level, full level, effective storage, storage percentage, outflow and flood control operation status for each reservoir, compiled from the WRA's emergency response system with data entered hourly or daily by each reservoir manager. The WRA produced the data and also publishes real-time water levels from its stations on central rivers and regional drainage, recorded every 10 minutes, and runs a water open data platform with datasets on reservoirs and weirs, hydrological statistics, rivers and drainage, land subsidence and disaster prevention, with an open API. Coverage is Taiwan. The data are free under the Open Government Data License version 1.0 as CSV, JSON and XML. Caveats: reservoir records arrive at different frequencies and are in principle updated once a day, the real-time water levels are raw data without quality checks, and history must be queried in the WRA's disaster prevention service. Simulation uses: reservoir storage and releases and river water levels for flood and drought emergency response and water supply planning. Related records: the K-water dam data (data-korea-kwater-dam-weir-hydrological-operation-data) and the Hong Kong reservoir data (data-hong-kong-wsd-open-data-reservoirs-supply-bursts).
